about: Shared cases for the valuation_jump alert's key (oe_connector/movements.py, valuation_key). The key is "valuation_jump:" plus the first 24 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps([company, item_code, warehouse], ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")): fixed at 39 characters, so never cut, unambiguous whatever the names hold, and always inside OpenExecutive's key charset. The title and evidence name the item and warehouse; the key only de-duplicates. OpenExecutive accepts a valuation_jump event only when its key fullmatches key_pattern, and drops any other (ladislav-urban/OpenExecutive#294, piece 3); it never recomputes the hash. This file is byte-identical in both repositories: a change lands in both together. oe_connector checks valuation_key gives every produced key exactly and that each fullmatches key_pattern; OpenExecutive checks its pattern equals key_pattern, accepts every produced key and drops every rejected one.
